jobs.description:
As an Office Assistant in Brussels, you will manage front-desk and office management activities for an international consulting firm and help ensure a smooth welcome for visitors and colleagues. You will keep daily reception tasks organised and provide reliable administrative support. 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

You will join an international consulting firm based in the center of Brussels. The office is easily accessible by public transports. 

Omschrijving

As an Office Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Welcome visitors professionally and direct them to the right contact or meeting area.
• Manage incoming calls and route messages accurately to support clear communication.
• Handle incoming and outgoing post, parcels and deliveries in an organised way.
• Keep the reception area tidy, presentable and ready for daily visitors.
• Coordinate meeting room bookings and help ensure rooms are prepared for use.
• Provide day-to-day administrative support.
• Order office supplies. 
• Respond to general enquiries and provide practical information to visitors and colleagues.

• You are perfectly bilingual in French and English, Dutch is a plus. 
• You have a first experience in receptionist, office management or administration. 
• Ability to manage a reception desk and greet visitors in a professional manner.
• Good organisational skills and proactive.
• Excellent communication skills.
• Good skills in MS Office.

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent) to support the Black Friday sale from 16 November until 4 December. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year, you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters for the Rieme warehouse

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Dampoort for the Desteldonk warehouse

• Departure at 5u10 

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

As an Operator in Hot Kitchen Department, you are responsible for independently operating various production machines. In this department, ingredients and prepared products are fried, cooked, steamed, mixed, and boiled.

Your responsibilities include operating equipment such as cooking kettles, filling machines, mixers, and combi steam ovens. You also prepare dishes and food components in accordance with our quality, hygiene, and safety standards.

 

What does the job involve?

As a Kitchen Operator, you are the right-hand person of the Team Leader in the Hot Kitchen Department, supporting them in the production of prepared dishes and food components.

You are responsible for preparing and carrying out recipes. Your tasks include:

• Taking over the duties of kitchen staff in their absence.

• Carrying out the necessary quality checks on raw materials and preparing them for processing when required. Depending on the workload, you work together with kitchen staff, providing them with clear instructions and guidance to ensure that their tasks are carried out correctly.

• Independently following and executing recipes in accordance with quality standards and IFS requirements.

• Ensuring that industrial equipment is properly cleaned after and between each production run, in accordance with hygiene regulations.

• Preparing spice blends according to the recipes when the Goods Receiving employee is absent.

• Correctly preparing frozen ingredients and recipe components according to the production order.

• Labelling semi-finished products and recording their use in our computer system.

• Recording cooling temperatures.

Requirements:

• You have a very good command of Dutch (speaking, reading, writing, and understanding). A good knowledge of English and/or French is an advantage.

• You are comfortable with basic calculations, reading weights, and using weighing scales.

• You have completed training in a culinary field (institutional catering, chef, catering assistant, or butcher) or have equivalent experience.

• You are familiar with food safety regulations.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are flexible and enjoy the challenge of switching between different departments.

• You can work well under pressure. Things can get quite busy at Marblo! 

• You maintain a neat and well-groomed appearance. For hygiene and safety reasons, gel nails, excessive make-up, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted in our production areas.

Do you have experience working with fabrics and know how to identify different pattern pieces? For a garment manufacturing company in the Tielt region, we are looking for someone to prepare fabrics for the cutting process and correctly sort the cut pattern pieces.

• You set up the machine and monitor the automatic unrolling and layering of the fabric.

• You take into account the fabric direction, warp and weft when preparing the materials

• You identify weaving defects and other irregularities and position the fabric in such a way that defective sections do not end up in the finished garments

• You check that the fabrics are correctly prepared and ready for the cutting machine.

• You collect the cut pieces and sort them according to the correct pattern.

• You group components such as sleeves, collars, front panels and back panels so they can be processed together in the next production stage.

• You follow the production schedule and ensure that the work progresses smoothly and efficiently.

 

• You have knowledge of fabrics and textiles, preferably gained through experience in a garment workshop or textile company.

• You can identify different garment components and pattern pieces.

• You can recognise fabric defects and know how to take them into account when laying out the fabric.

• You work accurately while maintaining a good production pace.

• You can count correctly and distinguish between colours, sizes and quantities.

• You have a sufficient understanding of Dutch to correctly interpret work instructions, numbers and labels. Knowledge of English is also an advantage.

• You are physically fit for the job and can work both independently and as part of a team.

• Sewing skills are not required. However, it is important that you can recognise fabrics and the different components of a garment.

For a banking customer in Brussels, we are searching for a freelance SQL DBA for a senior mission.
Responsibilities

• Help define, implement and maintain highly available, performant & scalable database systems to effectively meet IT Business requirements

• Be involved in deployment and patching automation

• Maintain (backups, transaction log management, index optimisation etc) and upgrade the database systems etc

• Review database schema changes to ensure compliance with standards and ensure optimal choice of indexing, column definitions etc.

• Help with problem solving in case of performance problems or functional issues in applications

• Build a strong relationship both within the infrastructure team and with the development teams

• Promote best practices

• Maintain the deployment pipeline

Additional details

Seniority: Medior/Senior

Start Date: October/November

Duration: Long-term

Extension: Yes

Contract: Freelance

Location: Brussels

Onsite Policy: 50%

Hours Per Week: 40

Languages: Fluent English and French/Dutch

Interview Process: 1 stage

• Expert knowledge of SQL Server administration, performance tuning, high availability and disaster recovery

• Strong experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, Oracle and enterprise database operations

• Hands-on experience with AWS database services (Aurora, RDS for SQL Server, PostgreSQL and MySQL, DynamoDB)

• Experience with Azure database services (Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, CosmosDB)

• Strong troubleshooting skills across database, operating system and infrastructure layers

• Experience with PowerShell and infrastructure automation

• Good knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory and Red Hat Linux

 

Strongly preferred:

• Experience with TerraForm, Ansible or similar Infrastructure-as-Code tools

• Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Redgate , Dynatrace, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor or equivalent

• Experience modernising legacy database platforms

• Experience with GIT, Jira and CI/CD-driven deployment processes

• Experience with cloud security, encryption, backup and disaster recovery solutions

• Experience with performance monitoring and capacity management in cloud environments

• Knowledge of Power BI, SSAS or reporting platforms

 

Nice to have:

• VMware vSphere and ESXi administration knowledge

• CommVault or enterprise backup solutions

• Basic networking and load-balancing (F5) concepts

• Azure Entra ID and Azure platform services

• Basic knowledge of Go or Python programming language

Soft skills

• Good communication skills enabling you to explain complex technical issues is an easy-to-understand way

• Like to keep up to date with the latest technology trends

• Fluent English and good knowledge of either French or Dutch

• Advanced investigation & problem solving skills with strong analytical skills

• Availability & flexibility

• Interested in cloud technologies and what the future may bring

• Have a clean certificate of good behaviour

Our client is a fast-growing B2B organization investing heavily in the optimization of its digital landscape. As part of this transformation, they are looking for a Freelance IT Business Process Lead to analyze, redesign, and document key business processes, with a strong focus on e-commerce and IT systems.

Jobomschrijving

As a Freelance Business Process Lead your responsibilities are:

• Analyze and map end-to-end business processes across multiple departments.
• Assess the interaction between business processes and IT systems.
• Redesign and optimize workflows to improve efficiency, scalability, and user experience.
• Document business processes, functional flows, and system interactions.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into functional process designs.
• Act as the interface between Business, IT, and external implementation partners.
• Support digital transformation projects related to e-commerce platforms and business applications.
• Ensure process governance, standardization, and adoption across the organization.
• Identify opportunities for automation and continuous process improvement.

A successful Freelance Business Process Lead should have:

• Proven experience as an IT Business Process Lead, Functional Analyst, or Process Consultant.
• Mandatory experience within a B2B e-commerce environment.
• Hand-on experience with Shopify or Magento is a great advantage.
• Strong understanding of business processes, system integrations, and digital workflows.
• Experience documenting business processes, functional specifications, and user journeys.
• Fluent in French and English.

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in the Brabant Wallon
jobs.description:
As part of the finance team, you will take ownership of several legal entities across Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg, with the opportunity to gradually expand your responsibilities and make a visible impact on the organization's future.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the full accounting cycle for several entities across Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg.
• Handle daily accounting operations, including purchase invoices, bank transactions, payments, reconciliations, and journal entries.
• Prepare monthly and year-end closings, provisions, accruals, and supporting financial analyses.
• Ensure timely VAT, Intrastat, and statutory reporting obligations are met.
• Prepare annual accounts and support audit activities in collaboration with the Chief Accountant.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of accounting processes and support ad hoc finance projects.

• Holds a degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent professional experience.
• Speaks fluent French and Dutch ; English is a great asset.
• Has solid end-to-end accounting experience and is comfortable managing entities autonomously.
• Has a strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting, VAT, and statutory obligations.
• Is structured, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.
• Demonstrates ambition, curiosity, and a willingness to take on increasing responsibilities over time.
• Thrives in a pragmatic, hands-on, and collaborative environment where initiative is valued.

jobs.occupation: Commercial Coordinator for the Beer Sector
jobs.description:
Our client is a main beer actor in the Belgian industry.They have a history of knowledge and expertise and are located in Flemish Brabant.

Jobomschrijving

As a Commercial Coordinator your responsibilities are very varied but with as a main goal to optimize all commercial, logistics and sales support processes in the company.Concretely you will:

• You work closely with Sales Support, Customer Service, Finance, Marketing, and Supply Chain to ensure efficient commercial operations
• You support and optimize all ongoing commercial processes and give insights on how to make the collaboration between sales, sales support and logistics more efficient
• You analyze commercial figures, market tendencies, promotions to increase commercial insights
• You analyze demand planning processes, market tendencies in the sector to make sure the forecasts are more accurate
• You support sales, sales support, customer service and logistics teams in using the CRM tool well
• You guarantee a flawless and efficient OTC process

The Commercial Coordinator should have:

• Fluent Dutch, French and English
• Analytical insights
• Able to understand different businesses and how an entire Order To Cash process works
• Good communication and influencing skills

Our client is a global market leader operating within complex international supply chains. From a strategic logistics hub in Belgium, the company manages large-scale transportation flows across Europe and continues to invest in the growth of its rail logistics operations.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate and monitor daily rail transportation activities across Europe.
• Manage transport disruptions, delays, and operational escalations.
• Act as the main point of contact between internal stakeholders and external transport partners.
• Monitor wagon availability, utilization, and transport capacity.
• Support sourcing of additional transport capacity when required.
• Prepare operational reports and track logistics KPIs.
• Follow up transport costs, documentation, and invoicing processes.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree.
• Initial experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or a related field is a plus.
• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data and Excel.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Comfortable operating in a dynamic international environment.
• Fluent English is required.

jobs.occupation: German Business developer | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company operating in the food industry. Combining the mindset of a family business with strong entrepreneurial ambitions, they offer a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where initiative, commercial drive and results are highly valued.To support their continued international growth, they are looking for a German-speaking Business Developer to further develop the German market.This position is 100% on-site in Antwerp.

Jobomschrijving

As a German Business Developer, you will play an active role in expanding the company's presence in Germany. You will have the opportunity to build your own network, develop new business and create long-term customer relationships.Your responsibilities include:

• Proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities within the German market.
• Reaching out to potential customers and opening new commercial doors.
• Building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiations and closing deals.
• Following up on commercial opportunities and developing your customer portfolio.
• Monitoring the German market and identifying new trends and opportunities.
• Tracking sales activities and results.
• Contributing ideas and market insights to the broader commercial strategy.

We are looking for someone with commercial drive, ambition and the motivation to make things happen. Previous experience is welcome, but your mindset and potential are just as important.

• You are fluent in German and English. Knowledge of Dutch or another language is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development or another commercial role is a plus, but definitely not a must.
• Motivated junior candidates and recent graduates are very welcome to apply. If you are eager to learn, commercially minded and excited by the idea of developing a market, we would love to hear from you.
• You are proactive and enjoy approaching new prospects and creating opportunities.
• You have strong communication and relationship-building skills.
• You are commercially minded and motivated by achieving results.
• You are a real go-getter who is not afraid to take initiative.
• You are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
• An affinity with the food industry is an advantage, but not required.
• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.
• You are happy to work 100% on-site in Antwerp.
